import json,os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bands=[]; cur=None
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        if any(v!=bg for v in row):
            cur=[i,i] if cur is None else [cur[0],i]
        else:
            if cur: bands.append(tuple(cur)); cur=None
    if cur: bands.append(tuple(cur))
    def extent(band):
        mx=-1; rowi=None
        for i in range(band[0],band[1]+1):
            js=[j for j,v in enumerate(g[i]) if v!=bg]
            if js and js[-1]>mx: mx=js[-1]; rowi=i
        return mx,rowi
    e0=extent(bands[0]); e1=extent(bands[1])
    comp,trunc=(e0,e1) if e0[0]>=e1[0] else (e1,e0)
    i=trunc[1]
    for j in range(trunc[0]+1, comp[0]+1): g[i][j]=1
    return g
'''
